verdict.rationale: Claude is itself the built-in assistant across its web, desktop and mobile apps. Its plans explicitly list handing off and scheduling tasks, and Claude Managed Agents provides a managed agent harness for long-running, asynchronous delegated work. The delegation evidence comes mostly from short pricing-page bullets and overview tables. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how in-app task hand-off and scheduling works, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
